name: Banner Knight
summary: A standard-bearing knight whose raised banner lifts allies' spirits and gives them second wind.
description: A banner knight carries the colors of a house, an order, or a city. As long as the banner stands, the troops fight; as soon as it falls, so do they, and everyone on the field knows it.

traits.name: Standard of Valor
traits.text: While the knight is conscious, each ally within 30 feet of it that can see the banner has {ref:glossary/advantage} on saving throws against the {ref:condition/frightened} condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The knight makes three Longsword attacks.

bonusActions.name: Raise the Banner
bonusActions.text: Each ally of the knight's choice within 30 feet that can see the banner gains 10 {ref:glossary/temporary-hit-points} and can use its {ref:glossary/reaction} to make one weapon attack.
